correctness.rationale: Exact affine conjugacy yields z_{n+1}=1-2|z_n|+(2-s)q s^n and q_{n+1}=s q_n. The moving-band boundary maps exactly to the next lower boundary, proving escape; a super-solution proves q<-1 has no bounded orbit. For q>0 two disjoint inverse branches cover the next band and each scale by 1/2, giving exact 2^N intervals and gap spectrum. Their convergent deletions have total length 2q, leaving Cantor length 2. Telescoping cylinder lengths gives the stated geometric first-escape law. Exact-rational standalone checker passed 160 parameter-depth combinations; finite checks only supplement the general argument.

value.rationale: The common stable multiplier defines a natural 2D two-saddle reduction and the ±2 unstable slopes yield the critical full-tent model. A complete global phase diagram for bounded initial data, parameter-independent positive fat-Cantor length and exact geometric escape distribution are substantive structural and quantitative properties. Fubini additionally shows an infinite-area bounded-state set even though individual transverse sections are nowhere dense; this is neither a routine local fixed-point calculation nor a known interval attractor result.
